claims.text: The model uses both adjacent entity mentions and surrounding words as local contexts for feature construction.
NCEL integrates local contextual features and global coherence information, indicating it uses more than just adjacent mentions.
The model's efficiency is achieved by considering a subgraph of adjacent mentions, but it also utilizes global features from surrounding mentions.
